video_title: Fred VanVleet Says Luka, LeBron and Reaves Were NEVER a Great Match

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet discusses the Rockets' strong start to the season
quotes.excerpt: Yukon, which is a very good school, they are number three in the country.
quotes.quote: Yukon, which is a very good school, they are number three in the country. Arizona, coming off a final four, obviously it's Arizona, we're 12 in the country, we're playing at home. Is that a big win or a good win?
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet on the Rockets home court expectations: You held home court against another top 10 team in the country. That is expected. I am not calling the guys being like big win guys. You did what you were supposed to do.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet explains the Rockets' expectations for home games
quotes.excerpt: When you go to a prestigious basketball academy like Arizona, we did what we were supposed to do.
quotes.quote: When you go to a prestigious basketball academy like Arizona, we did what we were supposed to do. You held home court against another top 10, top 12 team in the country. That's expected. I'm not calling the guys being like, man, big win guys, man, big win. I'm like, you did what you were supposed to do.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet on the Rockets mentality: We know who we are, and we are arrogant. It is fine.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet on the Rockets' performance on the road
quotes.excerpt: If Arizona goes to Chicago to play Illinois, we don't play in Champaign, where do we play?
quotes.quote: We only lost four or five games when I was in college on the road and every time they rushed the court. If Arizona goes to Chicago to play Illinois, we don't play in Champaign, where do we play? At the United Center. At the United Center. He knows it's the truth. This is a man that knows basketball, he knows it's the truth. We know who we are, and we are arrogant. It's fine.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet on Amen Thompson: He hit me with one of those crossovers his very first training camp. Just hard to guard. Moving very fast, explosive and quick.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet recalls Amen Thompson's impressive crossover move
quotes.excerpt: He hit me with one of those his very first training camp coming out of OTE.
quotes.quote: He hit me with one of those his very first training camp coming out of OTE. It was the first day of training camp he hit me with one of those crossovers, so I definitely seen it up close and personal. Just hard to guard. Moving very fast, explosive and quick.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet on Amen Thompson: It is the sky is the limit. He is in that unique position where he can carve out what kind of player he wants to be. He really can play all positions on the court.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet on the development and potential of Amen Thompson
quotes.excerpt: It's the sky's the limit. It's just like he's in that unique position where he can carve out.
quotes.quote: It's the sky's the limit. It's just like he's in that unique position where he can carve out what kind of player he wants to be. Do we want to be a Swiss army knife? Do we want to be dominant on the ball? There's different areas where he excels better than others, but he really can play all positions on the court and his on-ball activity and experience keeps growing. So we'll see, we'll see. It's really up to him.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet says Amen Thompson had his best training camp yet after changing his summer routine: He did a little bit less FIBA this year so he had more time to train and really come into camp fresh and ready to go.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet discusses Amen Thompson's improved training approach
quotes.excerpt: I think he really took and was really smarter about his summer this year.
quotes.quote: I think he really took and was really smarter about his summer this year. In previous summers, I know he had been playing FIBA all the way up until damn near August, September, and I think this year he did a little bit less than that, so he had more time to train and really come into camp fresh and ready to go. So this is the best I've seen him coming into camp.
quotes.social_post: Kendrick Perkins on Amen Thompson: I love the way that y'all use him because you cannot put him in a box. When he is on the floor, I love how he is playing the dunker spot, using him as a screen and roll guy. You just got to let him be him.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins praises the Rockets' use of Amen Thompson
quotes.excerpt: I love the way that y'all use Amen Thompson, because you're right, you can't put him in a box.
quotes.quote: I love the way that y'all use Amen Thompson, because you're right, you can't put him in a box. When he's on the floor with you, I love how he's playing the dunker spot, y'all using him as a screen and roll guy, like he's his versatility, like you just got to let him be him.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet on the Lakers situation with Luka Doncic: Him and Reaves and Brian was trying to figure out how to make it work, but that was never really a great match. Now it is his show, they got the guys that he wanted around him.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins highlights Luka Doncic's dominant performance
quotes.excerpt: One thing that's going on is that damn Luka Doncic, damn near averaging 40.
quotes.quote: One thing that's going on is that damn Luka Doncic, damn near averaging 40. Seriously, man, I just need to, you need to just tell us what you're seeing from him.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet on defending stars like Luka: I do not believe in letting nobody get nothing. Some guys you got to put two and three guys on the ball. It just is what it is. You got to wear them down.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet on Luka Doncic's comfort and team fit
quotes.excerpt: You can't deny what he's doing. He's playing at an all-time level, he looks super comfortable.
quotes.quote: You can't deny what he's doing. He's playing at an all-time level, he looks super comfortable. And we saw in Dallas, when everything is catered around him and you build the team around him, this is what you get. And I think that him, Brian and all of them was trying to figure out how to make it work, but that was never really a great match, just the way between him and Reeves and Brian. So now it's his show, they got the guys that he wanted around him.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet on returning to the court: Man I tell you what, it is the first time I have felt 32. I feel 32. They moving fast out there, bro. When I first got back out there in game speed, I am like damn, I do not remember the game being this fast.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet on defensive strategies against Luka Doncic
quotes.excerpt: I don't believe in letting nobody get nothing. That's the old school NBA.
quotes.quote: I don't believe in letting nobody get nothing. That's the old school NBA where it's like, oh, Kobe's going to score 40, but we're going to take everybody else. Well, like, nah, some guys you got to put two and three guys on the ball. It just is what it is. But you know, you're going to make them work, you got to wear them down, you got to make them guard, you're going to send multiple bodies at them, you're going to change the coverages up.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet on his recovery: The first time you see me on court does not mean that I am back 100 percent. I still have residual knee stuff and I do not feel like myself yet. This is not going to be the best version of me.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet discusses his physical recovery and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: Taking that year off and now you back in the monster that the monster you wanted, you love.
quotes.quote: Taking that year off and now you back in the monster that the monster you wanted, you love. But has it been a little bit of a, oh, okay, my body has to get used to this again? You know, because the clock got like off cycle. Man, I tell you what, it's the first time I've felt 32. I feel 32. They moving fast out there, bro. Like when I first got back out there in game speed, I'm like, damn, I don't remember the game being this fast.
quotes.social_post: Richard Jefferson on Fred VanVleet: One thing I hated about Kyle Lowry was he made the play that was required. And I think for Fred VanVleet, you will make a timely play that is required to stop a run.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet on his recovery from an ACL injury
quotes.excerpt: The first time you see me on court does not mean that I'm back 100%.
quotes.quote: The first time you see me on court does not mean that I'm back 100% and like this is tip-top shape and this is, you know, like I got to work my way up to that. I still have residual knee stuff and I don't feel like myself yet. I'm healthy enough to play, I'm super strong and solid and I feel great, but like this is not going to be the best version of me as what you see in the first couple weeks of the season.
quotes.social_post: Richard Jefferson on the Rockets: Fred VanVleet does not need to do a lot. He does need to do enough to make sure that people are happy, and as he is scaling and staying healthy, Houston can be dangerous if everyone understands their role.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet's impact mirrors Kyle Lowry's winning style
quotes.excerpt: Kyle Lowry might have 15, 9, 4, and three elite charges, right? And y'all win the game.
quotes.quote: I think for me, playing y'all, when you were in Toronto with Kyle Lowry, sometimes you look up and Kyle Lowry might have 15, 9, 4, and three elite charges, right? And y'all win the game. And one thing I hated about him was he made the play that was required. And I think for when I say like, oh, Fred VanVleet had a good game, you will make a timely play that is required to stop a run, to get somebody the right play, to say somebody, hey, chill out.
quotes.social_post: Richard Jefferson on elite players: After playing with Steve Nash and LeBron James and those kind of guys, Brandon Roy, they just make the right play when it is necessary.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet's role in the Houston Rockets' success
quotes.excerpt: Houston can be dangerous if everyone understands their role and accepts it
quotes.quote: Fred VanVleet don't need to do a lot. I mean, he does need to do enough to make sure that people are happy, and as he's scaling and staying healthy, because Houston can be dangerous if everyone understands their role and accepts it and knows that they're leaders, whether that's like defensive leader, offensive leader, whatever, is going to do the right play all the time.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet on the Rockets depth: That has been the biggest blessing this year is that we actually have a good team. So it does not all fall on me. I am definitely healthy enough to play my role on this group.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Great players consistently make the right play when necessary
quotes.excerpt: After playing with Steve Nash and LeBron and those kind of guys, they just make the right play.
quotes.quote: After playing with Steve Nash and LeBron James and those kind of guys, Brandon Roy, they just make the right play when it's necessary.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet on his relationship with Jalen Green: That is like my baby brother, man. I put a lot of time, energy and effort into developing that relationship. We built a real bond that goes deeper than just being a co-worker.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet on the importance of team depth
quotes.excerpt: That's been the biggest blessing this year is that we actually have a good team.
quotes.quote: That's been the biggest blessing this year is that we actually have a good team. So it don't all fall on me. I've been on some teams where I needed to score 20, 25 a night. I had a couple of those years after the championship years in between the year I made an All-Star team where I was the guy I had to do it every night. I'm not sure coming off an ACL with that type of responsibility, we would be having the same conversation, but I'm definitely healthy enough to play my role on this group and we got a pretty unselfish locked-in group.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet on his defensive role: I take pride in my defense, so that is where I feel it the most. I ain't never been called up in this many actions in my life. This team just, yeah. I am enjoying it.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins asks about Fred VanVleet's mentorship of Jalen Green
quotes.excerpt: I know you and Jalen Green were real close. Like I saw you take him under your wing.
quotes.quote: I know you and Jalen Green were real close. Like I saw you take him under your wing and stuff like that. Do you still, you know what I'm saying, your relationship is still there? Do you still, you know, tap in with him, give him a little some advice because he started off the season slow and he's still a young fellow with a promise and future, so wanted to know like the status of that relationship.
quotes.social_post: Fred VanVleet grades the Rockets start: I probably give us like a B-minus so far. We playing good enough, but not necessarily the level that where we want to be, but we winning while we are learning.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet on his relationship with Jalen Green
quotes.excerpt: That's like my baby brother, man. I put a lot of time, energy and effort into developing.
quotes.quote: That's like my baby brother, man. I put a lot of time, energy and effort into developing that relationship and working with him and just trying to help him in all facets of life on and off the court when I came to Houston. And we built a real bond. You guys know the bonds that you build that go deeper than just being a co-worker, you know what I'm saying? And he's definitely on that list of guys that we check in with each other.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: Fred VanVleet on his personal defensive adjustment and conditioning
quotes.excerpt: I ain't never been called up in this many actions in my life.
quotes.quote: For me personally, I take pride in my defense, so that's where I feel it the most. I ain't never been called up in this many actions in my life. This team just, yeah. I'm enjoying it. I'm getting my reps, I'm getting my legs in me. So definitely my defense will continue to get my legs sharper and just moving quicker. Offensively, it is what it is. I'm going to take big shots and do my thing. That's probably never going to change.

quotes.speaker: Fred VanVleet
quotes.summary_phrase: VanVleet evaluates team consistency and offensive execution challenges
quotes.excerpt: We playing good enough, but not necessarily the level that where we want to be.
quotes.quote: For our group, I think our energy and focus, our execution and our intention is great, but I think we struggle at times when our energy and our focus goes in and out. It's just been a little inconsistent. We need to sharpen that up. Offensively, there's a game plan to take us out of what we want to do, beat up on Kevin and pick me up full court and pressure, things like that that we can keep adjusting to. I probably give us like a B-minus so far. We playing good enough, but not necessarily the level that where we want to be, but we winning while we're learning, and that's a good place to be.
